text:
Sara: Hey team — I pushed a tiny cleanup in PR #2821: trimmed trailing whitespace, normalized a couple of docstrings. CI is red due to a lint/docstring error, can someone spare a quick review? I want to merge today if green.

Todd: Thanks for the ping. Quick glance — one docstring uses triple single-quotes and flake8-docstrings (pydocstyle) is complaining about D401 (first line should be short). Can you wrap the summary line to < 88 chars? :eyes:

Sara: Ah, that explains it. I thought we aligned on triple quotes, but missed the line length. I'll push a tiny fix.

Linh: Also saw an extra trailing space in handlers/notify.go line ~42, pre-commit would catch it but good to patch now.

Raj: If you run locally: `pre-commit run --all-files` and `black .` should fix most formatting. For the docstring wrap I usually do:

```
# rewrap first line to be short, then blank line, then details
"""Short summary under 88 chars.

Longer description here.
"""
```

Sara: Thanks — pushing followup commit with wrap + remove trailing space. Will force-push to the branch.

ci-bot: build/flake8 (PR #2821) — FAILED
Summary: pydocstyle D401 in src/service/notify.py: summary line too long

Todd: Quick check after your push — if CI still fails I can take it and tidy. Otherwise a quick `LGTM` from me once green. :thumbsup:

Sara: Pushed fix (force-pushed). Patch is 1 line docstring wrap + removed trailing space. Command I ran: `git commit --amend -m "docstring: wrap summary" && git push --force-with-lease`

ci-bot: build/flake8 (PR #2821) — PASSED :white_check_mark:
ci-bot: build/tests (PR #2821) — PASSED :white_check_mark:

Todd: LGTM, thanks for the quick follow-up.

Linh: looks good to me too, nice catch.

Sara: Thanks all — merging now. :shipit:

Raj: Nice, thanks for handling the follow-ups.

Sara: Noted for next time: I'll run pre-commit locally before opening the PR to reduce churn.

Todd: Optional: we could add a tiny CI check to fail early on long docstring summary lines specifically, but not necessary for this small fix.

Sara: Agreed — filing a tiny follow-up task to consider a pydocstyle gate.

ci-bot: message archived.
